2607.09338.title: Towards Detecting Inconsistencies in End-to-end Generated TODs
2607.09338.paper_summary: Generative AI is profoundly transforming the core technologies behind conversational systems, shifting from component-based to end-to-end approaches. However, Large Language Models (LLMs) may still generate inconsistencies, a critical issue particularly in Task-Oriented Dialogues (TODs), where system responses must strictly adhere to information from a domain knowledge base (e.g., restaurants in a city). A single hallucination (e.g., suggesting a non-existent restaurant) can lead to severe task failures. We investigate a method for automatically detecting inconsistencies by conceptualizing TODs as a Constraint Satisfaction Problem (CSP), where variables represent dialogue segments referencing the conversational domain, and constraints among variables capture dialogue properties such as turn coherence and adherence to domain knowledge. We propose a pipeline that first identifies variables in a target dialogue and then applies a CSP solver to identify valid solutions. By comparing the target dialogue with valid variable assignments, we can detect inconsistencies and suggest minimal changes to ensure dialogue consistency. We demonstrate the high accuracy of the CSP-based approach in detecting inconsistencies, and provide a detailed analysis of our findings.
2607.09338.paper_summary_zh: 生成式人工智慧正在深刻改變對話系統背後的核心技術，從基於組件的方法轉向端到端的方法。<lb/>然而，大型語言模型（LLMs）仍可能產生不一致性，這在任務導向對話（TODs）中是一個關鍵問題，因為系統的回應必須嚴格遵循來自領域知識庫的信息（例如，城市中的餐廳）。<lb/>單一的幻覺（例如，建議一個不存在的餐廳）可能導致嚴重的任務失敗。<lb/>我們研究了一種通過將TODs概念化為約束滿足問題（CSP）來自動檢測不一致性的方法，其中變量代表引用對話領域的對話片段，變量之間的約束捕捉對話屬性，如回合一致性和對領域知識的遵循。<lb/>我們提出了一個管道，首先識別目標對話中的變量，然後應用CSP求解器來識別有效的解。<lb/>通過將目標對話與有效的變量分配進行比較，我們可以檢測不一致性並建議最小的變更以確保對話的一致性。<lb/>我們展示了基於CSP的方法在檢測不一致性方面的高準確性，並提供了我們發現的詳細分析。
